notes.title: Ver.1.0.2 Update
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141766/ef1670c271ab466055f73f76bbfdefac827d3423.png"]



We’ve released an update with the following changes:
[olist]
The hitbox for Thunder during the appearance of the Adv. Thunder Machine lasted about 0.5 seconds longer than intended, which did not match the visuals.

Made minor adjustments to the cutscene before the final boss fight.

Adjusted the railgun’s charge completion sound.
[/olist]
Regarding Update 1, we apologize for any unintended damage this may have caused.





[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141766/6c43f3412279a97c7bbd376cff309b9ce99dc911.png"]

notes.title: Ver.1.0.1 Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141766/746982dbb48bf92c10b9359bee530442b8f53619.png


We’ve released an update with the following changes:

[olist]
 Fixed an issue where the missile from the Assault Vehicle boss behaved unexpectedly when dodged by the player in certain situations.
 Improved Korean translations.
 The result screen now displays an additional icon when certain special conditions are met.
[/olist]

We apologize for any inconvenience caused by these issues.
